notes.title: ChefU Changelog September 5, 2017
notes.content:
We have made some exciting changes to the game and revamped the way things are carried around. You now have the ability to lock and unlock objects to containers. Held items will also not collide with some surfaces to make it easier to teleport with many items in containers.

Update Highlights:
[list]
    [*] You can use the trigger to lock and unlock items now
    [*] 2 types of locomotion (more to come soon)
    [*] Various tweaks and fixes (check beta changelog for more details)
[/list]

Best Regards,
Lockem Reality Team

notes.title: ChefU Beta Changelog September 1, 2017
notes.content:
We are experimenting with new types of locomotion and have them on the beta branch. Check it out on the beta branch, we are also experimenting with a different approach to containers. We are still fine tuning these new features and will push them to live when we think they are ready. If you are eager to give it a try, you can switch to the beta branch on steam. 

Instructions to switch to beta branch:
Right click on ChefU in your steam library and click properties.
Select the Betas tab.
Enter the password 'cookingwithfire' 
Opt into the beta branch and ChefU should switch to the beta version.
Have fun with the beta and don't forget to leave us feedback or suggestions. 
 
[list]
    [*] New Locomotion Slide to position 
    [*] Oculus can rotate with X and A keys when using Slide to position locomotion
    [*] Ability to lock items to a containers for example (cutting board, pots, pans, bowls and etc)
    [*] Items in containers now can be locked and unlocked with the trigger
    [*] Highlighting held items that are locked and are in no clip mode
    [*] Held items can now clip into some surfaces to reduce teleporting held items and causing a mess
    [*] Fixed issue with teleporting messing up the drawers and its contents
    [*] Removed ability to stick knives to surfaces
    [*] Increased the mass of several items
    [*] Increased grip drop threshold
    [*] Increased collider sizes on knives
[/list]

Best Regards,

Lockem Reality Team

notes.title: ChefU Changelog August 29, 2017
notes.content:
Based on your feedback, we have made the following changes in ChefU:

[list]
    [*]Modified physics to create more stable containers
    [*]Modified physics to reduce objects passing through each other
    [*]Increased durability of plates
    [*]General performance improvements
    [*]Increase global gravity
    [*]Fixed issue with seasoning ingredients
    [*]Corrected some typos
[/list]

We are still making fixes and improvements to the experience of ChefU. Look forward to different types of locomotion in the next update.

Best Regards,
Lockem Reality Team
